hooks.command: f="$HOME/.claude/.haiku-scribe-onboarded-route"; [ -f "$f" ] || { mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude"; printf '%s' 'haiku-scribe is installed: a read-only Haiku scout that compresses broad reads (4+ files, logs, transcripts, surveys, unfamiliar flow) into a short brief. When the main model starts a broad read (recursive search, many files), a routing hook declines it once and points at the scout; a retry goes through. Disable routing: HAIKU_SCRIBE_ROUTE=off. This note fires once.'; touch "$f"; }
